hebrewText: מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜/ם חָכְמַת לֵ֗ב לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֮ כָּל מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ וְ/חֹשֵׁב֒ וְ/רֹקֵ֞ם בַּ/תְּכֵ֣לֶת וּ/בָֽ/אַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּ/תוֹלַ֧עַת הַ/שָּׁנִ֛י וּ/בַ/שֵּׁ֖שׁ וְ/אֹרֵ֑ג עֹשֵׂי֙ כָּל מְלָאכָ֔ה וְ/חֹשְׁבֵ֖י מַחֲשָׁבֹֽת

tokens.bdb: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
tokens.kjv: accomplish, confirm, [phrase] consecrate, be at an end, be expired, be fenced, fill, fulfil, (be, become, [idiom] draw, give in, go) full(-ly, -ly set, tale), (over-) flow, fulness, furnish, gather (selves, together), presume, replenish, satisfy, set, space, take a (hand-) full, [phrase] have wholly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to fill or  be full of
tokens.enLiteralWord: to fill or  be full of
tokens.explanation: to fill or  be full of
tokens.explanationEn: to fill or  be full of

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: wisdom (in a good sense)
tokens.kjv: skilful, wisdom, wisely, wit.

tokens.bdb: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
tokens.kjv: [phrase] care for, comfortably, consent, [idiom] considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), [idiom] heed, [idiom] I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), [idiom] regard(-ed), [idiom] themselves, [idiom] unawares, understanding, [idiom] well, willingly, wisdom.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings
tokens.enLiteralWord: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings
tokens.explanation: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings
tokens.explanationEn: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings

tokens.bdb: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
tokens.kjv: accomplish, advance, appoint, apt, be at, become, bear, bestow, bring forth, bruise, be busy, [idiom] certainly, have the charge of, commit, deal (with), deck, [phrase] displease, do, (ready) dress(-ed), (put in) execute(-ion), exercise, fashion, [phrase] feast, (fight-) ing man, [phrase] finish, fit, fly, follow, fulfill, furnish, gather, get, go about, govern, grant, great, [phrase] hinder, hold (a feast), [idiom] indeed, [phrase] be industrious, [phrase] journey, keep, labour, maintain, make, be meet, observe, be occupied, offer, [phrase] officer, pare, bring (come) to pass, perform, pracise, prepare, procure, provide, put, requite, [idiom] sacrifice, serve, set, shew, [idiom] sin, spend, [idiom] surely, take, [idiom] thoroughly, trim, [idiom] very, [phrase] vex, be (warr-) ior, work(-man), yield, use.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor)
tokens.kjv: business, [phrase] cattle, [phrase] industrious, occupation, ([phrase] -pied), [phrase] officer, thing (made), use, (manner of) work((-man), -manship).

tokens.bdb: a fabricator or any material
tokens.kjv: artificer, ([phrase]) carpenter, craftsman, engraver, maker, [phrase] mason, skilful, ([phrase]) smith, worker, workman, such as wrought.

tokens.bdb: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
tokens.kjv: (make) account (of), conceive, consider, count, cunning (man, work, workman), devise, esteem, find out, forecast, hold, imagine, impute, invent, be like, mean, purpose, reckon(-ing be made), regard, think.

tokens.bdb: to variegate color, i.e. embroider; by implication, to fabricate
tokens.kjv: embroiderer, needlework, curiously work.

tokens.bdb: the cerulean mussel, i.e. the color (violet) obtained therefrom or stuff dyed therewith
tokens.kjv: blue.

tokens.bdb: purple (the color or the dyed stuff)
tokens.kjv: purple.

tokens.bdb: the crimson-grub, but used only (in this connection) of the colorfrom it, and cloths dyed therewith
tokens.kjv: crimson, scarlet, worm.

tokens.bdb: crimson, properly, the insect or its color, also stuff dyed with it
tokens.kjv: crimson, scarlet (thread).

tokens.bdb: bleached stuff, i.e. white linen or (by analogy) marble
tokens.kjv: [idiom] blue, fine (twined) linen, marble, silk.

tokens.kjv: weaver(-r).
